accepted.name: The Scatter
accepted.premise: The band breaks at your roar and runners peel off along every open line.
accepted.loop: For a few strides you are faster than they are. Each runner flees along a visible line toward the dark; you cut lines by moving through them. You cannot reach every line — every step toward one runner opens another's escape.
accepted.signals: Escape routes read as the runners' own paths and the gaps between rocks; a runner you head off stops dead and cowers; an escaped runner shrinks into the dark still carrying the story.
accepted.outcome_win: Everyone you head off turns shallowly to your color, trembling.
accepted.outcome_fail: The ones who escape spread the tale of you outward to camps you have never seen.
accepted.why_fun: Chase geometry as instant triage — commitment costs are visible the moment you move, and you cannot catch everyone by design.
accepted.gdd_quote: you have a handful of strides to cut off the runners

accepted.name: Steady the Flame
accepted.premise: A grey band circles you at the edge of the firelight, wavering between approach and flight.
accepted.loop: Your flame breathes on its own; holding space feeds it, releasing lets it fade. Each nomad drifts inward only while the light sits inside their comfort — too bright and the nearest flinch back, too dim and the farthest turn away. The correct move is usually to do less.
accepted.signals: Brightness is the flame itself; each nomad's comfort shows in their posture — leaning in, shielding their eyes, or turning; commitment shows as kneeling.
accepted.outcome_win: Those who reach you kneel and take your color deeply; the fire settles.
accepted.outcome_fail: A flare or a fade; the flinchers freeze grey, ringed in your color, and the rest scatter.
accepted.why_fun: Restraint under temptation — the urge to feed the flame is the trap, and the skill is modulation, not action.
accepted.gdd_quote: commit only if the flame is steady when they arrive

accepted.name: The Procession
accepted.premise: A rooted settlement resists you everywhere but along your own roads.
accepted.loop: You walk your road toward the heart and converts fall in behind you, one by one. The line holds only while your pace stays slow and your turns stay wide; move too fast or cut too sharply and the tail detaches where you rushed. Whoever is still with you at the heart converts a resident.
accepted.signals: The line of followers IS the state — its length, its gaps, and the stragglers left standing where the line broke.
accepted.outcome_win: The unbroken line reaches the heart; residents step out and kneel.
accepted.outcome_fail: The line breaks; whoever you dropped stands where you lost them, and the settlement's doors close.
accepted.why_fun: The leader's restraint is the skill — the whole tension is between the pace you want and the pace the line can hold.
accepted.gdd_quote: the line breaks if you move too fast or turn too sharply

accepted.name: The Watch
accepted.premise: Your believers are points of light and the dark presses in from every side.
accepted.loop: You hold a shadow-shield over one cluster at a time while the dark gnaws at every unshielded light. Coverage is the shield's own shadow; the pressure visibly shifts, and you drag your protection between clusters knowing the rest are burning down.
accepted.signals: A shielded cluster sits in your cast shadow and burns steady; an unshielded cluster gutters, dims, and greys — the flame height itself is the state.
accepted.outcome_win: Dawn arrives with the clusters you chose still burning.
accepted.outcome_fail: The lights you abandoned are grey by morning, standing exactly where you left them.
accepted.why_fun: Triage under guaranteed loss — the skill is deciding what to lose, and living with it.
accepted.pattern_source: Triage — protect what you can; Diegetic state display
accepted.gdd_quote: You shield what you can and you cannot shield everything

accepted.name: The Weaving
accepted.premise: Sleep takes you; your believers hang in the dark as points of your color.
accepted.loop: With your last stamina you draw a thread from believer to believer with slow movements. The thread holds only while your pace stays gentle and your turns stay wide; a rushed segment frays and snaps. Longer chains reach further and are harder to hold.
accepted.signals: The thread is drawn light between bodies; fraying shows as the thread thinning and trembling; a completed chain settles into a steady channel glow.
accepted.outcome_win: Completed chains carry belief between the sleepers all generation.
accepted.outcome_fail: A snapped thread leaves its two ends dark; unchained believers stand alone against the grey.
accepted.why_fun: The ambition tradeoff — every extra link is reach you want and risk you must hold with smoother hands.
accepted.gdd_quote: Completed chains become channels belief travels while you are gone
